Glass_Containers.title: How to Properly Recycle Glass Containers
steps: Collect glass containers like jars and bottles used for food and beverages.
Rinse thoroughly to remove food residue or liquids.
Remove lids or caps as some recycling centers ask for them separately.
Sort by color if required (e.g., clear, brown, green) for better recycling.
Place clean glass containers in the designated glass recycling bin or take to a recycling center.
Encourage reuse where possible before recycling.
Spread awareness about the importance of glass recycling.
precautions: Do not throw broken glass into regular recycling bins to avoid injury.
Avoid mixing glass with non-recyclable items.
Do not burn glass containers.
Do not throw glass containers in landfill if recycling options are available.
Store glass safely to prevent breakage before disposal.

Paper_Products.title: How to Properly Recycle Paper Products
steps: Collect newspapers, magazines, cardboard, office paper, and packaging paper.
Ensure paper is clean and dry, free from food or oil stains.
Flatten cardboard boxes to save space and facilitate processing.
Do not mix paper products with wet or greasy items.
Place clean paper products in the paper recycling bin or take to a recycling center.
Consider reusing paper or cardboard for crafts or storage.
Educate others on separating paper waste for recycling.
precautions: Do not recycle paper contaminated with food, oil, or chemicals.
Avoid recycling wax-coated paper or tissues.
Do not burn paper products as they can release harmful chemicals.
Do not mix paper with plastics or metals in recycling bins.
Store paper in a dry place to prevent mold before recycling.

Plastic_Bottles.title: How to Properly Recycle Plastic Bottles
steps: Collect plastic bottles used for drinks, cleaning products, or personal care items.
Rinse thoroughly to remove any liquids or residue.
Remove caps and labels if required by your local recycling guidelines.
Sort bottles by type (e.g., PET, HDPE) if requested by recycling centers.
Place the clean plastic bottles in designated plastic recycling bins or take them to a recycling facility.
Reuse plastic bottles where possible for storage or crafts.
Raise awareness about the impact of plastic waste and recycling practices.
precautions: Do not throw plastic bottles in compost or organic waste bins.
Do not burn plastic bottles.
Avoid mixing with non-recyclable plastics.
Do not crush bottles if your recycling center requests them intact.
Store plastic bottles in a dry area to avoid contamination before recycling.

Cans_All_Types.title: How to Properly Recycle All Types of Cans
steps: Collect aluminum and steel cans such as soda cans, food cans, and paint cans (if empty).
Rinse cans to remove leftover food or liquid.
Remove labels if required by your recycling facility.
Flatten cans if requested to save space.
Place clean cans in the designated metal recycling bin or drop-off point.
Consider reusing cans for crafts or storage.
Spread awareness of the benefits of recycling cans.
precautions: Do not recycle cans that are not empty or contain hazardous materials.
Avoid crushing cans unless the recycling center permits.
Do not throw cans into compost or organic bins.
Do not burn cans.
Store cans safely to avoid injury or contamination before recycling.
